title: Basic
description: Primitive types shared by every other schema. Mirrors OpenMetadata's type/basic.json so the two models line up where they overlap.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Business key, dot-separated: service.database.schema.table.column. Segments containing a dot are quoted, which is why matching must be segment-aware and never a raw LIKE 'x.%' (FR-2A.2).

provenance.description: Where a facet or attribute came from. Local values are never overwritten by a sync (FR-1.7).
